nuances.title: Default to usted in service calls
nuances.ai_likely_does: Defaults to tú (English-centric, treats all 'you' as neutral), or mixes tú and usted within one turn
nuances.native_does: Spanish-speaking caller and agent use usted throughout a cold service call: '¿Me podría ayudar?', 'Quisiera consultar...'; verbs, clitics and possessives stay 3rd person ('su reserva', 'le confirmo'). Switching to tú reads as rude or non-native

nuances.title: Clitic/possessive agreement with usted
nuances.ai_likely_does: Keeps usted in the verb but slips to informal clitics/possessives: 'le confirmo tu correo', 'te mando su factura'
nuances.native_does: Person is consistent: 'le confirmo su correo', 'le envío su factura'. Mixed te/su in one breath instantly flags a non-native

nuances.title: Translationese for 'I'd like / I need'
nuances.ai_likely_does: Calques English politeness: 'Me gustaría a...', 'Necesito que tú...', overuses 'Puedo tener...' ('Can I have...')
nuances.native_does: Uses native softeners: 'Quería consultar...', 'Quisiera...', 'Le quería preguntar...', 'A ver si me puede ayudar'. 'Quería' (imperfect) is the idiomatic service opener, not 'quiero'

nuances.title: Verbalizing the email @ and dot
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says 'at' / 'arroba' inconsistently and reads '.com' as 'dot com' or 'punto com' with English 'com'
nuances.native_does: '@' = 'arroba', '.' = 'punto', '_' = 'guion bajo', '-' = 'guion' (or 'guion medio'); 'gmail.com' = 'gmail punto com'. e.g. 'juan arroba gmail punto com'

nuances.title: Phone numbers grouped in pairs
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads phone numbers digit-by-digit (English style) or in three-digit groups
nuances.native_does: Groups in pairs as two-digit numbers: 612 345 678 → 'seis, doce, treinta y cuatro, cincuenta y seis, setenta y ocho'; Latin American mobiles often grouped differently but still chunked, not pure digit-string

nuances.title: Dates: day-month order and 'el … de …'
nuances.ai_likely_does: Uses month-day order or ordinals for all days ('el primero/segundo/tercero de…')
nuances.native_does: Day before month with cardinals: 'el quince de marzo'; only the 1st may be ordinal in some regions ('el primero', LatAm) vs cardinal 'el uno de' (Spain). Year as full number: 'dos mil veinticinco', not 'veinte veinticinco'

nuances.title: Decimal comma and currency phrasing
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads money as '$19.99' = 'diecinueve punto noventa y nueve' and uses point for decimals
nuances.native_does: Decimal = coma: '19,99 €' = 'diecinueve euros con noventa y nueve' or 'diecinueve con noventa y nueve'; thousands separator is a point. 'con' links euros/cents

nuances.title: Gender of nouns and adjective/article agreement
nuances.ai_likely_does: Mis-genders or mis-agrees, esp. tricky nouns: 'la problema', 'el reserva', 'un orden' (for sequence), wrong adjective ending 'la vuelo cancelada'
nuances.native_does: el problema, la reserva, el vuelo cancelado, la tarjeta bloqueada; agreement is automatic across article+noun+adjective+participle

nuances.title: Native airline/telecom/retail terms vs English calques
nuances.ai_likely_does: Uses anglicisms/calques: 'cancelar mi booking', 'el refund', 'hacer un return', 'mi data plan', 'check-in' said English-style
nuances.native_does: 'mi reserva', 'el reembolso/la devolución', 'una devolución', 'mi tarifa de datos/plan de datos', 'facturación' or naturalized 'el check-in'; 'reembolso' not 'refund'

nuances.title: Alphanumeric codes: native letter names + spelling alphabet
nuances.ai_likely_does: Spells letters with English names ('A B C' as /ei bi si/) or uses NATO/English spelling words ('B as in Bravo')
nuances.native_does: Spanish letter names ('be', 'uve/ve', 'i griega/ye', 'hache', 'jota', 'doble u') and Spanish clarifiers: 'B de Barcelona', 'N de Navarra'. Double letter: 'doble ele' or 'dos eles'

nuances.title: Native hesitation markers
nuances.ai_likely_does: Inserts English-shaped fillers ('um', 'uh') or none at all; overuses 'pues' mechanically
nuances.native_does: Uses 'eh…', 'este…' (LatAm), 'o sea', 'a ver', 'pues nada', 'es que…' to preface a problem ('Es que no me llegó el reembolso')

nuances.title: Confirmation backchannels
nuances.ai_likely_does: Translates 'okay/right/got it' as repeated 'bien'/'okay' or silence
nuances.native_does: 'vale' (Spain) / 'dale', 'ya', 'ajá', 'de acuerdo', 'perfecto', 'correcto'; affirming comprehension with 'sí, sí' doubled is natural, not emphatic

nuances.title: Region-locked lexicon must stay consistent
nuances.ai_likely_does: Mixes Peninsular and LatAm markers in one persona: 'vale' + 'ahorita' + 'coger el vuelo' + 'vosotros' alongside 'ustedes'
nuances.native_does: Stays coherent: Spain → 'vale', 'coger un vuelo', 'vosotros', 'móvil'; LatAm → 'okay/dale', avoids 'coger' (vulgar in much of LatAm; use 'tomar/abordar'), 'ustedes', 'celular', 'ahorita'

nuances.title: Service-call politeness routines
nuances.ai_likely_does: Over-thanks in English pattern ('Thank you so much' → 'Muchas gracias por tu tiempo') or uses bare imperatives that sound brusque
nuances.native_does: '¿Sería tan amable de…?', 'Cuando pueda', 'Si no es molestia', 'Disculpe que le moleste'; closes with 'Muy amable, gracias' / 'Que tenga buen día'. Requests softened with conditional/imperfect

nuances.title: 'Esperar' for hold, not calque of 'hold on'
nuances.ai_likely_does: Calques 'hold on' / 'let me check' as 'sostener' or 'déjame chequear' (chequear is an anglicism flagged in formal register)
nuances.native_does: 'Un momento, por favor', 'Permítame que lo compruebo/lo reviso', 'No cuelgue, por favor'. 'comprobar/revisar/consultar' over 'chequear'

nuances.title: Ser/estar and por/para distinctions
nuances.ai_likely_does: Confuses ser/estar ('mi cuenta es bloqueada' instead of estar) and por/para ('gracias para tu ayuda')
nuances.native_does: 'mi cuenta está bloqueada' (state), 'el cargo es de 20 euros'; 'gracias por su ayuda', 'es para el día quince'. These map poorly from English and are high-tell errors

nuances.title: Number gender agreement with nouns
nuances.ai_likely_does: Uses invariant 'uno/veintiuno' before feminine nouns: 'veintiuno tarjetas', 'uno reserva'
nuances.native_does: Apocope/feminine: 'una reserva', 'veintiún euros', 'veintiuna tarjetas', 'doscientas millas/personas' vs 'doscientos euros'

nuances.title: Telling time the native way
nuances.ai_likely_does: Calques digital clock: 'las tres treinta', 'a las diez cuarenta y cinco'
nuances.native_does: 'las tres y media', 'las once menos cuarto' (Spain) / 'cuarto para las once' (LatAm), 'las diez y cuarto'; 24h in transport contexts acceptable but everyday speech prefers fractions
